verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API that runs on localhost inside the desktop app and works fully offline. A versioned OpenAPI spec is published, and a headless CLI server is offered for automation and scripting. Together these give developers a documented local endpoint for reading, searching, creating and modifying objects from scripts and agents. Missing for 10: no evidence of a URI scheme or deep links for opening a specific note in the app UI, and no independent hands-on corroboration of scripting against the local API.
